current_boundary: Paper12 supports local weak-supervision adaptation evidence, not a validated ArcGIS replacement claim.

decision_rule.not_validated: Use when independent manual ground truth, ArcGIS reference output, or Paper12 checkpoint-backed output is missing.
decision_rule.partial: Use when all paired outputs exist but Paper12 does not meet the replacement threshold on at least one primary metric or critical class.
decision_rule.replacement_candidate: Use only when Paper12 matches or exceeds the ArcGIS reference on the same manual labels, area, time window, and taxonomy.
decision_rule.insufficient_sample_size: Use when paired outputs exist but the evaluator has fewer than the minimum manifest rows required for a replacement-candidate decision.
decision_rule.insufficient_class_coverage: Use when paired outputs exist but independent manual labels do not cover every required critical class.
decision_rule.insufficient_class_row_coverage: Use when paired outputs exist and every critical class appears, but at least one required critical class appears in too few independent manifest rows for a replacement-candidate decision.

next_actions: Run scripts/prepare_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py to create the manual annotation packet before filling paired-evidence manifest fields.
Run scripts/audit_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py --min-candidate-rows 30 to inspect packet evidence readiness, sample-size readiness, and next actions.
Sample and manually annotate Linhe validation patches or polygons using the highest-resolution imagery available.
Export ArcGIS or Esri reference predictions for the same samples and class taxonomy.
Run scripts/export_paper12_packet_predictions.py with the Paper12 checkpoint-backed Houlsby workflow on the same samples.

Run scripts/finalize_arcgis_replacement_validation_packet.py --min-candidate-rows 30 to create an evaluator-ready manifest once manual, ArcGIS, and Paper12 masks exist while recording sample-size readiness.
Report per-class IoU, overall accuracy, macro F1, and confusion matrices for both systems against the same manual labels.
Run scripts/evaluate_arcgis_replacement.py on the finalizer manifest with --bootstrap-iterations 1000 --min-candidate-rows 30 --min-critical-class-rows 3 before changing decision_status.

coverage_diagnostics.critical_class_support: valid manual pixels or scalar labels per critical class
coverage_diagnostics.critical_class_row_support: manifest rows containing each critical class after ignore-index filtering
